ns2:course.label: Model & Ctrl Electromech Syst
ns2:course.description: Examines fundamental electrical and mechanical laws for derivation of machine models; simplifying transformations of variables in electrical machines; power electronics for motor control; time-scale separation; feedback linearization and nonlinear control as applied to electrical machines. Typical electromechanical applications in actuators, robotics, and variable speed drives. Same as ME 565. Prerequisite: ECE 431 and ECE 515; or consent of instructor.
